target: Future measured composite stiffness conditional on continued recorded survival
timing_contract: Use cycle count, prescribed strain, supplied cure/header-frequency metadata and early E0 calibration only; no failure-cycle normalization or future measured stiffness. Exact header-frequency acquisition timing is undocumented; the selected log equation does not use frequency, while comparators condition on its availability. Expanded information budget: cycle, E0_GPa, strain_percent, frequency_Hz, cure
calibration: See frozen development protocol and per-fold states; all learned calibration is training-partition-only. E0 is the median native stiffness at cycles 10–20 for the same specimen; later stiffness and terminal cycle are unavailable to predictors.
reference_selection: First preregistered continuation candidate; other development-ranked candidates remain separate models, not new held-out selections.
